description.narrative: The global objective is to strengthen the ability of Kenyan civil society to actively shape the digital transformation while promoting an inclusive rights-based digital `commons¿ in Kenya. The project will equip front-line rural CSOs/CBOs with the tools, technical skills and coalitions that enable them to harness AI tools and data-driven OSINT (open-source intelligence) techniques to safeguard digital democracy.
